mapper.sql: user_id, username, display_name, password_hash, status, TO_CHAR(create_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS create_time, TO_CHAR(update_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS update_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM app_user WHERE lower(username) = lower(#{username})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO app_user (user_id, username, display_name, password_hash, status) VALUES (#{userId}, #{username}, #{displayName}, #{passwordHash}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM app_user ORDER BY create_time, user_id

SELECT count(DISTINCT u.user_id) FROM app_user u JOIN user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.user_id JOIN app_role r ON r.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE u.status = 'ENABLED' AND u.user_id <> #{excludedUserId} AND (r.builtin = TRUE OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM role_permission rp WHERE rp.role_id = r.role_id AND rp.permission_code = #{permissionCode}))

SELECT r.role_id, r.name, r.description, r.builtin, TO_CHAR(r.create_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS create_time, TO_CHAR(r.update_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS update_time FROM app_role r JOIN user_role ur ON ur.role_id = r.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY r.create_time, r.role_id
SELECT DISTINCT rp.permission_code FROM role_permission rp JOIN user_role ur ON ur.role_id = rp.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY rp.permission_code
